meaning: Source-level Node cases executed during validation of the bound artifact; compiled document tasks are reported separately in revision15-browser.json and mobile-accessibility.json.

tests.name: The source contains a real nine-action shuffle prefix and two audited physical decks
A single assumed draw branches over every remaining physical copy without changing the source
The unique Marmot draw has a zero-action conditional witness and exact one-in-34 mass
Reports identify a hypothetical analysis and never certify an observed draw or competitive win rate
The ordinary causal engine still refuses an unknown draw and offers no favorable-draw action
A turn draw hypothesis does not open Droll or mutate its source response windows
Each branch can be re-verified freshly, including immediate goals with no fabricated combo step
The drawn Normal Monster reaches the field through actual Standby, Main and Summon actions
A conditional Fusion continuation preserves real material payments and source-zone consequences
Two requested copies cannot be supplied by the one physical Marmot, and absence stays unknown
Scalar goal conditions are evaluated together with the physical card requirement
Branch and state budgets preserve all unvisited probability mass instead of calling it failure
Mo Ye cannot reveal a second unknown card after a verified first-draw hypothesis
Pre-cancellation returns a cancelled result and leaves the source intact
Out-of-range or noninteger exploration options are rejected
A legitimate prefix outside the own unknown Draw window is not admitted
An unverified manual unknown-order declaration cannot replace the real shuffle prefix
Forged source state, prefix costs, context, goal and competitive claims are rejected
An imported report rejects altered physical UID sets, card identities and exact weights
Imported totals, source goals, context and assumed-draw claims cannot be inflated
A witness rejects tampered final state, recorded payment, phase and hypothesis event
A physically valid alternative goal is still a different import source
Changed build, catalogue and same-date restriction content invalidate old reports
Return values remain detached, and invalid verification does not alter the original report
The manual laboratory may expose a real rival Trap while hypothetical continuations use only own actions
A changed live laboratory goal cancels exploration and rejects an otherwise valid old report
The exported report limit is measured in UTF-8 bytes rather than JavaScript characters

limitations: This Node suite uses source modules and pinned technical cards and TCG snapshot, not a new official-ruling authentication.
The first draw is explicitly hypothetical under a uniform-shuffle assumption; all subsequent witnessed actions use the ordinary causal engine.
Only a single own turn draw with opponent PASS is admitted. Unknown continuations are not proved failures, competitive win rates or general optimal play.
